hotels.title: Brisbane Escape next to Gabba Stadium with Daily Breakfast & Rooftop Pool
hotels.description: Match days at The Gabba, festivals at South Bank, riverside drinks at Kangaroo Point - Brisbane's biggest moments happen right outside Swiss-Belhotel Woolloongabba. The hotel sits 20 metres from the stadium and is a quick walk from South Bank, with stylish rooms and a rooftop restaurant and bar that offer views of the city skyline. Swiss-Kitchen™ Restaurant & Bar crowns Level 12, serving sensational breakfast accompanied by sweeping city views. Between outings, take a dip in the rooftop plunge pool or stay active in the 80-square-metre fitness centre overlooking The Gabba.
